name: FrontController
summary: One handler for every request, which then dispatches to the command that serves it.

roles.name: Handler
roles.summary: The single entry point every request passes through. Because there is exactly one, what is common to all requests — authentication, locale, logging, routing — is written once and cannot be forgotten on the page added last.

roles.name: Command
roles.summary: What one request actually does, chosen by the handler. It is created per request rather than looked up on a shared object, which is what keeps a front controller free of the state a page controller can afford.
